submit_form_edit.text:
sequenceDiagram
  actor User
  participant Web as Web app
  participant API
  participant DB as Database
  User->>Web: submit form
  activate Web
  Web->>API: POST /forms
  activate API
  API->>API: validate
  alt valid
    API->>DB: insert
    DB-->>API: row
    API-->>Web: 201 created
  else invalid
    API-->>Web: 422 errors
  end
  deactivate API
  Web-->>User: confirmation, or the errors
  deactivate Web
  loop every minute
    Web->>API: GET /status
    API-->>Web: status
  end
  Note over User,Web: the form stays open until the status is final
  User->>Web: close
  Web->>API: DELETE /session
  API-->>Web: 204
  Web-->>User: signed out
